About Paradromics
Brain-related illness is one of the last great frontiers in medicine, not because the brain
is unknowable, but because it has been inaccessible. Paradromics is building a brain-
computer interface (BCI) platform that records brain activity at the highest possible
resolution: the individual neuron. AI algorithms then decode this massive amount of
brain-data, enabling the seamless translation of thought into treatments.
